containers.name: intangible-valuation
containers.notes: The node's own Next.js release (node server.js, not a standalone .next) copied into the image; uid 1001 is the deploy user the unit ran as. The app has no AUTH_SECRET anywhere — the unit's env file carries only PORT — so NextAuth logs MissingSecret on every request in production too; behaviour is identical between unit and container.

containers.name: intangible-valuation-api
containers.notes: Python WSGI app (api.index:handler) behind pylaunch, served from the node's own venv and work directory copied to the same paths so shebangs resolve. pylaunch binds 127.0.0.1 unless --host 0.0.0.0 is passed, which the entrypoint does. The ALB group probes TCP because the app has no health path.

containers.name: intangible-valuation-mcp
containers.notes: Same image as the API, different entrypoint (api.mcp:handler) on 8060. The repository's own Dockerfile is the stdio MCP for the registry and is unrelated.
